articles.title: Show HN: HackerBooks – HackerTube, but for books recommended on HN
articles.summary:
Saw Karpathy's HackerTube and wanted the same thing for books. So I had Claude build one (Opus 5.5).
It's ~16.5k books that at least two different HN commenters brought up, from 2007 till now. Each book links back to the comments that mentioned it. Data is downloadable from the about page.
To be clear: Claude wrote almost all of it, including the data pipeline and the site. I mostly steered and made calls, bought the domain name, etc.
It counts mentions, so it's not perfect (praising a book and trashing it both count). If your favourite book is missing or matched to the wrong thing, tell me.

articles.title: Heavy hydrogen in 3I/ATLAS's methane points to a frigid birthplace
articles.source: Phys.org - latest science and technology news stories
articles.summary: The interstellar comet 3I/ATLAS carries a chemical clue to conditions in the planetary system of its origin, locked away long before it reached our sun. Its methane signature is unusually rich in heavy hydrogen, suggesting that the comet's frozen ingredients took shape in an intensely cold environment around another star—or in the cloud that preceded it.
